label: Original-phase steps 3-5 of sequences that begin with digit 2
explanation: Fires in the original (input) phase at positions 3-5, almost only when the first original token is the digit 2 (first_tok=2 holds 91% of activation mass, 24x lift). Activation peaks at t=4 and is near zero after t=6. It never fires in the copy phase. It fires weakly at the delimiter step (1.6% of mass) in short sequences that start with 2. Within 2-initial sequences, some earlier tokens in positions 1-2 (j, p, z, b, f, a, s) make it fire more often and more strongly: adding seen() of those tokens raises precision from 0.39 to 0.57 but costs recall, so that token dependence is not part of the predicate. It does not fire at t<3. It is mostly silent in sequences whose first token is not 2. About half of predicted steps stay inactive, so precision is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: 2, g, 3, c, o, h; least: a, s, f, d) and the previous input (most: p, f, s, a, j, b; least: -, 2, h, x); timing cues that raise it most: t=4, t=3, t=5.
